entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: Non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: US military university that hosts significant X3D research and tool development.

entities.name: Virginia Tech
entities.note: University with a strong presence in Web3D research, particularly through the Visionarium.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: German research institute that originally developed the X3DOM framework.

entities.name: Bitmanagement Software GmbH
entities.note: Company providing commercial X3D viewer technology (BS Contact).

entities.name: Daly Realism
entities.note: Consultancy heavily involved in X3D standardization and Web3D Consortium leadership.

entities.name: ISO/IEC JTC 1
entities.note: International standards body that ratifies X3D specifications.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: Consortium managing standards like glTF and WebGL, which X3D integrates with.

entities.name: Kshell Analysis
entities.note: Consultancy involved in X3D CAD and Web3D Consortium activities.

entities.name: University of Suwon
entities.note: South Korean university active in Web3D standards and Web3D Korea.

entities.name: Chungbuk National University
entities.note: South Korean university contributing to X3D Medical working group efforts.

entities.name: Monterey Bay Aquarium Research Institute
entities.note: Oceanographic research center utilizing X3D for underwater visualization.

entities.name: DICOM
entities.note: Medical imaging standard organization that the Web3D Medical WG collaborates with.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: Long-time Web3D Consortium board member and X3D Working Group co-chair at NPS.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: Web3D Consortium President and Director of the Advanced Research Computing Visionarium at Virginia Tech.

entities.name: Leonard Daly
entities.note: Web3D Consortium board member and co-author of X3D books.

entities.name: Richard F. Puk
entities.note: Key contributor to X3D specifications and ISO liaison.

entities.name: Anita Havele
entities.note: Executive Director of the Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: Johannes Behr
entities.note: Original architect of the X3DOM framework at Fraunhofer IGD.

entities.name: Vince Marchetti
entities.note: Web3D Consortium board member and active contributor to X3D CAD standards.

entities.name: Myeong Won Lee
entities.note: Professor at University of Suwon and active participant in Web3D standards.

entities.name: Kwan-Hee Yoo
entities.note: Professor at Chungbuk National University and contributor to the Medical Working Group.

entities.name: Tony Parisi
entities.note: Co-creator of VRML, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: Mark Pesce
entities.note: Co-creator of VRML alongside Tony Parisi.

entities.name: Mike McCann
entities.note: Web3D Consortium board member representing MBARI.

entities.name: Andreas Plesch
entities.note: Active open-source maintainer and contributor to the X3DOM project.

entities.name: Holger Seelig
entities.note: Creator and primary maintainer of the X_ITE X3D browser.

entities.name: X3D Working Group
entities.note: Primary group within Web3D Consortium responsible for developing the X3D standard.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: Web3D subgroup focused on integrating X3D with medical imaging standards.

entities.name: Heritage Working Group
entities.note: Web3D subgroup focused on cultural heritage preservation using X3D.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard.

entities.name: VRML
entities.note: Virtual Reality Modeling Language, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: Open-source JavaScript framework that integrates X3D nodes directly into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: Open-source WebGL X3D browser developed by Create3000.

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: Open-source authoring tool for X3D scenes developed at Naval Postgraduate School.

entities.name: Web3D Conference
entities.note: Annual international conference on 3D web technology hosted by the Web3D Consortium.
